"The Marshall Plan helped the economic revival of Western Europe after the Second World War. The EU's economic influence extends to its neighbours in Europe, Asia and Africa. The EU has evolved from an economic union to an increasingly political one, with its own flag, anthem and currency."

items.answer: (i) Marshall Plan (ii) The common currency of the European Union introduced in 2002, which could challenge the dominance of the US dollar. (iii) It needed economic revival, aided by the Marshall Plan, and wanted to prevent future wars.
